ammonia.reason: Extensive amino-acid deamination to ammonium nitrogen (~0.26% AN) drives pH to 7.66 with free NH3 pungency.

animal_barnyard.reason: Red-smear Brevibacterium linens/coryneforms plus p-cresol from tyrosine breakdown give stable-animal note.

bitter.reason: Accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from plasmin and LAB proteinases unmasked by near-zero fat.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, so no C7-C11 methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue aroma.

browning.reason: Very low fat and <1% residual sugar limit Maillard despite high lysine protein when heated.

buttery.reason: Skim acid curd ~0.1% fat gives almost no milkfat lactones and little diacetyl/acetoin creaminess.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine catabolism by smear flora yields 3-methylbutanoic/2-methylbutanoic sweaty acids.

creaminess.reason: 0.13% fat provides no fat-globule lubrication; dense acid casein gel feels dry-waxy.

crumbliness.reason: Young acid curd is short but outside-in smear proteolysis makes ripe paste plastic-translucent, not crumbly.

firmness.reason: Acid quark pressed to 32-45% dry matter with dense low-fat casein network gives firm rubbery bite.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol gives faint rose-honey.

fruity.reason: Yeast esterases form low levels of ethyl esters from ethanol and acids despite fat limitation.

goaty.reason: Cow skim milk contains no goat-specific caproic/caprylic and 4-methyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 3-methylbutanal from leucine gives malty note; no cooked nutty pyrazines.

melt.reason: Acid-precipitated demineralized low-fat casein softens but does not flow when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Minimal 1-octen-3-ol earthiness; no white-mold mushroom flora.

oil_off.reason: Essentially fat-free, so no free-oil exudation on heating.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from LAB acid coagulation plus acetic acid from yeasts, partly deacidified by smear to pH 7.6.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; acid curd lacks aligned calcium-paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Brevibacterium linens methionine gamma-lyase produces methanethiol, dimethyl disulfide/trisulfide.

sweet.reason: Residual carbohydrate <1% fully fermented; sour-bitter-ammonia suppresses sweetness.

umami.reason: Deep proteolysis releases glutamate/aspartate with NaCl synergy in fat-free protein matrix.
